audience: agencies and project teams that plan tasks and log time in awork

useCases.title: Read the structure of a project
useCases.text: Open a project, then list its task lists and task statuses, and read one task by id with its due date and assignees.

useCases.title: Review logged time per person
useCases.text: List time entries with their duration, task and billable state, and the users who logged them.

useCases.title: Log time on a task
useCases.text: List the types of work, then create a time entry for a user with a start time and a duration in seconds.

useCases.title: Create a task and comment on it
useCases.text: Create a project task or a private task, then post a comment on it. Each call creates a new task or comment.

useCases.title: Look up a client company
useCases.text: List the client companies of the workspace and open one to read its details.
